supported_claim: FaithDial edits unsupported Wizard of Wikipedia responses and can supervise generation and hallucination critics.
scope_caution: Do not treat it solely as a detection benchmark or general LLM factuality guarantee.

supported_claim: Self-Knowledge Tuning improves self-evaluation; long-form atomic-claim scores are averaged to rank responses and construct response-level DPO preference pairs.
scope_caution: Self-evaluation can share generator errors; claim scoring does not make its DPO objective sentence-level.

supported_claim: FactAlign combines response-level KTO with sentence-level fKTO; a sentence is a continuation given the prompt and preceding sentences, with binary support labels from retrieved Wikipedia evidence.
scope_caution: Sentence-level binary feedback requires no sentence preference pairs; Wikipedia support is not unrestricted world truth.

supported_claim: UAlign computes confidence and semantic entropy, trains an uncertainty-conditioned reward model, and performs PPO alignment.
scope_caution: Estimated uncertainty is a knowledge-boundary proxy, not correctness ground truth.

supported_claim: RHIO masks retrieval heads for negative generation, trains with control tokens, and uses self-induced contrastive decoding.
checked_level: official abstract plus PDF section inspection
scope_caution: Hybrid method; correlation between retrieval heads and faithfulness is not a complete causal explanation.

supported_claim: Self-RAG learns retrieval and reflection tokens; inference uses relevance/support/utility and candidate selection.
evidence_locator: Section 3; PDF pp. 3–6; Appendix A.3 pp. 17–19
scope_caution: Requires training/reflection supervision; not merely a generic self-check prompt.

supported_claim: Astute RAG elicits internal knowledge and iteratively consolidates internal/external evidence with source awareness.
evidence_locator: Abstract; related-work distinction on PDF p. 3; method on pp. 5–6
checked_level: official abstract plus PDF section inspection
scope_caution: Training-free and black-box applicable; reliability assessment is model-dependent.

supported_claim: CAD contrasts context-conditioned and context-free token distributions with context exponent 1+alpha and context-free exponent alpha.
evidence_locator: Section 2.2; PDF p. 2 / printed p. 784; Limitations p. 6 / 788
scope_caution: Strengthens context adherence; no claim of exactly 2x wall-clock latency or verifying source truth.

supported_claim: DoLa contrasts mature-layer and premature-layer log probabilities on a plausible-token set; dynamically selects a premature candidate layer using maximum Jensen–Shannon divergence from mature predictions.
scope_caution: This uses internal layer outputs and does not independently verify facts.

supported_claim: TruthX learns semantic and truthful latent spaces with an auto-encoder and contrastive learning, then edits representations.
evidence_locator: Section 3 and Figure 2; PDF pp. 2–4 / printed pp. 8909–8911
checked_level: official abstract plus PDF section inspection
scope_caution: Inference-time intervention does not mean no auxiliary training; avoid universal truth-direction claim.

supported_claim: Lookback Lens trains logistic regression on attention-ratio features and uses detector-guided candidate decoding.
scope_caution: Needs labels and internal attention maps; detector transfer reported for selected settings only.

supported_claim: CoVe performs drafting, verification-question planning, independent answers, and revision.
scope_caution: Independence means prompt separation, not an external factual source.

supported_claim: CRITIC uses appropriate external tools to critique initial output and iteratively revise it.
scope_caution: Task-specific tool feedback; do not generalize QA outcomes from code/toxicity experiments.

supported_claim: SEAL learns a selective rejection token and regularizes decoding using its probability.
scope_caution: Token-level rejection learning; not merely thresholding response refusal.

supported_claim: Stable-RAG targets hallucinations induced by permutations of retrieved passages.
scope_caution: Do not invent a shared evaluation protocol with Astute RAG; proposed factorial experiment is survey synthesis.

supported_claim: Associated hallucinations can overlap with factual recall in the studied internal representations and evade detectors.
evidence_locator: Abstract and Introduction; PDF pp. 1–2 / printed 713–714; Sections 3–5
scope_caution: Bound to factual recall/settings studied; does not disprove every internal method.

supported_claim: Controlled experiments find response-length effects on long-form factual precision.
scope_caution: No universal claim that every longer answer is worse; no numerical gain borrowed across protocols.

supported_claim: ICAT checks atomic claims against retrieved evidence and measures their alignment with expected aspects.
scope_caution: Coverage is not identical to raw number of claims or correctness alone.

supported_claim: Similar balanced accuracy can hide instance disagreement, TPR/TNR tradeoffs, and system-error estimation bias.
scope_caution: Focus is AutoAIS/source attribution; do not generalize to all metrics without qualification.

supported_claim: Source-attribution judges show sensitivity to paraphrase and distant evidence; human validation on new domains is recommended.
scope_caution: Independent evaluation to avoid optimizing the same verifier is survey inference from the documented biases.

supported_claim: Temporal misalignment of benchmark reference facts can distort factuality assessments.
scope_caution: Versioning and periodic review are recommendations; do not claim all benchmarks are invalid.

supported_claim: Reasoning prompts can reduce hallucination occurrence while obscuring cues used for detection in the studied models and settings.
scope_caution: Joint-validation protocol and shared-verifier failure hypothesis are survey proposals; no universal claim about intervention composition.

supported_claim: On Llama 65B biography generation, few-shot versus CoVe factor+revise yields FActScore 55.9 versus 71.4 and mean fact count 16.6 versus 12.3.
evidence_locator: Table 3 (PDF p. 7, printed p. 3569); experimental setup in Section 4.1.4
checked_level: Primary PDF Table 3 and experimental setup checked
scope_caution: Same-study, same-model comparison; not a matched-length causal ablation. Precision gains accompany reduced fact count, without establishing a causal length effect.
